sources.title: D. Bar-Natan and A. Stoimenow, The Fundamental Theorem of Vassiliev Invariants

contents.name: Definition 1.1: finite-type invariant and extension to singular knots
Definitions 1.4–1.5: singular-knot filtration and differentiation map
contents.reason: The pair defines finite differences directly and does not use the filtered group algebra or its differentiation map in any proof.

contents.name: Proposition 1.6: a finite-type invariant gives a functional on the degree quotient
Proposition-Definition 1.7: chord diagrams represent singular knots modulo differentiation
Conjecture 1.2 and Question 1.3: separation of knots and knot orientation
contents.reason: These classification questions are unrelated to the local derivative and weight-system claims, and no separation claim is made in this pair.

contents.name: Questions 1.8–1.9: integration of weight systems
contents.reason: The converse integration proof is deliberately reserved for KT-35; KT-34 records its established status without using it as a premise.

contents.name: Theorem 1.10: exactness with topological 4T and framing-independence knots
contents.reason: This stronger exact-sequence statement is not needed for the necessary 4T and 1T relations proved locally in KT-34.

contents.name: Remark 1.12: exact rows for the knot-filtration diagram
contents.reason: The pair does not use the filtered knot algebra or its exact-row diagram; the derivative proof is given directly.
